description.en: A fossil palm frond fans out around a strong costa extending from an unarmed petiole.
description.zh: 化石棕榈叶围绕由无刺叶柄延伸的强中肋扇形展开。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Sabalites colaniae, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Sabalites colaniae 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Costapalmate folded segments differ from pinnate cycad leaves and continuous Ginkgo fan laminae.
distinctness.zh: 具中肋掌状折叠叶段区别于羽状苏铁叶及连续银杏扇叶。

modeling_brief.en: Use long accordion-like sectors around the projecting costa; keep the fossil outline and omit an assumed trunk.
modeling_brief.zh: 沿伸出中肋制作长手风琴状折区，保留化石外形并省略假定树干。

uncertainty: Leaf morphotaxon; complete palm, fruit and crown arrangement are not known from this specimen.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Leaf fossils of Sabalites from the Oligocene of northern Vietnam
sources.supports: Sabalites colaniae fan-shaped costapalmate leaves and unarmed petiole.
